note: Written by hand from gator's own backlog, not drawn from real unit history. Extend it with real tasks as outcomes accumulate.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Lease store to SQLite
tasks.task: Migrate the lease store from flocked JSON files to SQLite across leases.py, health.py and the gator shell script, preserving fail-closed semantics on corrupt state, with a migration path for existing .gator/sched state and tests for concurrent acquisition.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: RFC 8785 canonical plans
tasks.task: Replace the hand-rolled plan canonicalisation with RFC 8785 JSON canonicalisation across save, load and hashing, keeping every plan stored under the old scheme verifiable and refusing any plan whose bytes could hash two ways.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Preempt standard work
tasks.task: Let a waiting heavy unit preempt a running standard unit on the 5090: stop the worker, checkpoint its worktree, requeue it with its original admission time, and prove no committed work is ever lost or merged twice.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: gator auto run
tasks.task: Implement gator auto run: execute an approved plan's selected candidate, enforce its scope against the resulting diff, bind the verifier recorded in the plan, and refuse on any stale binding, with exit codes per spec section 4.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Fair queue across repos
tasks.task: Make the queue fair across repositories sharing one scheduler store, with a starvation bound that is asserted in tests, touching leases.py, policy.py and drain_queue in the gator shell script.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Streaming plan extractor
tasks.task: Rewrite the planner output extractor as a streaming JSON parser with a hard memory bound, preserving every existing refusal code and the fenced-block preference, and prove the bound with a test that feeds it an adversarial stream.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Port feed to Python
tasks.task: Port the feed path of the gator shell script to Python while keeping byte-identical output, identical exit codes, the same trust gate for repository config, and every existing test green.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Cross-host leases
tasks.task: Allow leases to be held in a store shared between hosts over NFS: correct locking semantics, fencing tokens so a stale holder cannot act, and recovery when a host dies while holding a lease.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Resident scheduler
tasks.task: Introduce an optional resident scheduler daemon that owns leases, with a crash-safe handoff so the existing file-based path keeps working, unchanged, whenever the daemon is down or absent.

tasks.label: heavy
tasks.title: Force-updated branches
tasks.task: Detect and repair unit worktrees whose branch was force-updated while the unit ran, across status, wait and merge, without ever merging a commit the verifier did not see.
